+def calibrate(robot):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video='none')
+    q0, x0 = pstate(obs)

+    J = np.zeros((3, 7))

+        qnew, xnew = pstate(result)
+        dq = qnew[i] - q[i]
+        J[:, i] = (xnew-x)/dq
+        q, x = qnew, xnew
+    print('J', np.round(J, 4), flush=True)
+    np.savez(STATE, J=J, q=q, x=x)
+
+
+def goto(robot, target, grip=-1., tol=.015, max_iter=18, label='goto'):
+    saved = np.load(STATE)
+    J = saved['J'].copy()
+    q = saved['q'].copy(); x = saved['x'].copy()
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video='none')
+    qobs, xobs = pstate(obs)
+    if np.linalg.norm(qobs-q) > 1e-4:
+        dq = qobs-q; dx = xobs-x
+        J += np.outer(dx-J@dq,dq)/(dq@dq+1e-9)
